Advance Wars - Dual Strike.name: Advance Wars: Dual Strike
Advance Wars - Dual Strike.summary:
Advance Wars: Dual Strike is the third installment in the Advance Wars series (first on DS media). Advance Wars is the international title of the Wars video game series, which dates back to the Family Computer game Famicom Wars in 1988.
The storyline is a continuation of the previous series and is set in the new location of Omega Land. Black Hole has returned under the leadership of a new commander who seeks to give himself eternal life by draining the energy of Omega Land. The Allied Nations struggle to overcome this threat and are eventually joined by several former Black Hole commanding officers in an effort to save the land.

I'm a Celebrity - Get Me Out of Here!.name: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!
I'm a Celebrity - Get Me Out of Here!.summary:
Based on the hit British-born television reality show.

Join the celebrities deep in the heart of the jungle ...

Isolated from all the luxuries of modern life, you will have to endure Bush Tucker trials, Bush Battles, vote-off and everything the jungle can throw at you! Do you have what it takes to win? You can play solo or with 2 to 4 players, but only one can triumph and become King or Queen of the jungle!

Madagascar - Escape 2 Africa.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
Madagascar - Escape 2 Africa.summary:
Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa DS is a third-person action-platformer based on the movie of the same name.

All of the Madagascar characters are available for play, including Alex, Gloria, Melman, and the giant Moto-Moto, each with their own unique moves. Players explore the African savanna, climbing, jumping, swimming, confusing tourists, finding monkeys, and collecting items along the way.

Mahjongg DS.name: Mahjongg DS
Mahjongg DS.summary: Experience the world famous Chinese board game! Play your way through numerous tricky levels at different difficulty levels in a setting of beautifully drawn backdrops. Enjoy endless playing pleasure either in Single-Player or 2-Player Mode on a Nintendo DSi system. Use powerful extras such as Dynamite, Whirlwind, and Hourglass and become the uncontested Mahjong champion!

MechAssault - Phantom War.name: MechAssault: Phantom War
MechAssault - Phantom War.summary: MechAssault: Phantom War is one of the games in the popular MechWarrior series and is part of the BattleTech universe created by FASA. Players assume the role of a BattleMech pilot in a 3D environment with a third person view of the combat via the top screen of the DS, while the touch screen displays the inside of the cockpit and acts as the game's controls.

Real Stories - Veterinaire.name: Real Stories: Veterinaire
Real Stories - Veterinaire.summary: This Wii-game in 3D offers a perfect and realistic simulation of the No. 1 job of most children: Veterinarian! The player can handle over 30 different cases of animal patients that correspond to reality in a veterinary practice and have been developed by specialists in the field. A variety of different animal species needs medical attention, and the player must use all the techniques of a good veterinarian such as talking to the owners, analysis and diagnosis, treatment, surgery, control to heal the little darlings. Realistic diagnosis and treatment instruments are used, and as the experience grows, the player can even earn diplomas and distinctions in addition to the great satisfaction of his patients. The game offers three different levels of difficulty, plus a knowledge quiz with 150 questions. The game is using the Wii's own controller Wiimote and Nunchuck And allows a realistic immersion in the veterinarian world: the player can actively handle or operate animals, even in multiplayer, where two players can perform a complex treatment together.

Shin Lucky Star Moe Drill - Tabidachi.name: Shin Lucky Star Moe Drill: Tabidachi
Shin Lucky Star Moe Drill - Tabidachi.summary: The sequel to Lucky Star Moe Drill, this follow-up to the first game features new quizzes and minigames to test players on their skills and knowledge.

Super Speed Machines.name: Super Speed Machines
Super Speed Machines.summary: A fast paced racing game for the Nintendo DS
